200.description: The extension version, with its new valid state.

id.description: Unique identifier of the extension version.

valid.description: Whether this version is approved for deployment. This is the human approval decision, not the scanner's verdict — see `scan_state`.

label.description: Label recorded when the jar was uploaded.

resourceKey.description: S3 object key of the uploaded jar. Absent until an upload is confirmed.

keycloakMajorVersion.description: Keycloak major version this version targets. Absent for version-independent extensions.

scan_state.description: Result of the security scan: `UNSCANNED`, `SCANNING`, `PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK` or `ERROR`. Never absent.

risk_score.description: Risk score from 0-100 reported by the scan. Absent until a scan has completed.

report_location.description: Location of the full scan report, when one exists.

scanned_at.description: When the version was last scanned, as epoch milliseconds.

scanner_version.description: Version of the scanner that produced the result.

override_by.description: ID of the user who approved this version despite the scan not passing. Cleared when the approval is withdrawn.

created_at.description: When the version was created, as epoch milliseconds.
